natural_language_question: How many employees are in each department?
gold_sql:
SELECT Department, COUNT(*) AS employee_count
FROM employee_directory
GROUP BY Department
ORDER BY employee_count DESC, Department;

natural_language_question: Which projects are currently in progress?
gold_sql:
SELECT Project_ID, Project_Name, Department, Budget_USD, Spent_USD, End_Date
FROM project_budget
WHERE Status = 'In Progress'

natural_language_question: Which suppliers are marked as preferred?
gold_sql:
SELECT Supplier_ID, Supplier_Name, Country, Category, Quality_Score, On_Time_Delivery_Pct
FROM supplier_scorecard
WHERE Preferred = 'Yes'
ORDER BY Supplier_Name;

natural_language_question: What is total revenue, total profit, and profit margin by product category?
gold_sql:
SELECT Category,
       ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(SUM(Profit) * 100.0 / SUM(Revenue), 2) AS profit_margin_pct
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY Category
ORDER BY total_profit DESC;

natural_language_question: Which departments have an average annual salary above 100000?
gold_sql:
SELECT Department,
       COUNT(*) AS employee_count,
       ROUND(AVG(Annual_Salary), 2) AS avg_salary
FROM employee_directory
GROUP BY Department
HAVING AVG(Annual_Salary) > 100000
ORDER BY avg_salary DESC;

natural_language_question: For each supplier, how many inventory items do they supply and what is the total inventory value?
gold_sql:
SELECT s.Supplier_ID,
       s.Supplier_Name,
       COUNT(i.Item_ID) AS item_count,
       ROUND(SUM(i.Total_Value), 2) AS total_inventory_value
FROM supplier_scorecard s
JOIN inventory_tracker i
  ON s.Supplier_ID = i.Supplier_ID
GROUP BY s.Supplier_ID, s.Supplier_Name
ORDER BY total_inventory_value DESC;

natural_language_question: Which salespeople generated more than 100000 in total revenue?
gold_sql:
SELECT Salesperson,
       COUNT(*) AS order_count,
       ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS total_profit
FROM sales_data
GROUP BY Salesperson
HAVING SUM(Revenue) > 100000
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC;

natural_language_question: Which projects have used more than 70% of their budget?
gold_sql:
SELECT Project_ID, Project_Name, Department, Status, Budget_USD, Spent_USD, Pct_Used
FROM project_budget
WHERE Pct_Used > 70
ORDER BY Pct_Used DESC;

natural_language_question: Rank employees within each department by performance score, then salary, and return the top 2 per department.
gold_sql:
WITH ranked AS (
  SELECT Employee_ID,
         First_Name || ' ' || Last_Name AS employee_name,
         Department,
         Level,
         Annual_Salary,
         Performance_Score,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY Department
           ORDER BY Performance_Score DESC, Annual_Salary DESC
         ) AS dept_rank
  FROM employee_directory
)
SELECT Employee_ID, employee_name, Department, Level, Annual_Salary, Performance_Score, dept_rank
FROM ranked
WHERE dept_rank <= 2
ORDER BY Department, dept_rank;

natural_language_question: For each sales region, what is the best-selling product by total revenue?
gold_sql:
WITH product_region AS (
  SELECT Region,
         Product_Name,
         ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS total_revenue,
         ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS total_profit,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
           PARTITION BY Region
           ORDER BY SUM(Revenue) DESC
         ) AS rn
  FROM sales_data
  GROUP BY Region, Product_Name
)
SELECT Region, Product_Name, total_revenue, total_profit
FROM product_region
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY Region;

natural_language_question: Which inventory items are supplied by vendors with below-average defect rates and have stock below or equal to their reorder point?
gold_sql:
WITH supplier_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(Defect_Rate_Pct) AS avg_defect_rate
  FROM supplier_scorecard
)
SELECT i.Item_ID,
       i.Item_Name,
       i.Stock_On_Hand,
       i.Reorder_Point,
       s.Supplier_Name,
       s.Defect_Rate_Pct
FROM inventory_tracker i
JOIN supplier_scorecard s
  ON i.Supplier_ID = s.Supplier_ID
CROSS JOIN supplier_avg a
WHERE s.Defect_Rate_Pct < a.avg_defect_rate
  AND i.Stock_On_Hand <= i.Reorder_Point
ORDER BY s.Defect_Rate_Pct ASC, i.Item_ID;

natural_language_question: For each department, compare project spending to employee payroll and return departments that have both project budgets and employees.
gold_sql:
WITH payroll AS (
  SELECT Department,
         COUNT(*) AS employee_count,
         ROUND(SUM(Annual_Salary), 2) AS total_payroll
  FROM employee_directory
  GROUP BY Department
), project_spend AS (
  SELECT Department,
         COUNT(*) AS project_count,
         ROUND(SUM(Budget_USD), 2) AS total_budget,
         ROUND(SUM(Spent_USD), 2) AS total_spent
  FROM project_budget
  GROUP BY Department
)
SELECT p.Department,
       p.employee_count,
       ps.project_count,
       p.total_payroll,
       ps.total_budget,
       ps.total_spent,
       ROUND(ps.total_spent / p.total_payroll, 2) AS spent_to_payroll_ratio
FROM payroll p
JOIN project_spend ps
  ON p.Department = ps.Department
ORDER BY spent_to_payroll_ratio DESC;

natural_language_question: Find monthly revenue and profit in 2024, including month-over-month revenue change.
gold_sql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Order_Date) AS order_month,
         ROUND(SUM(Revenue), 2) AS monthly_revenue,
         ROUND(SUM(Profit), 2) AS monthly_profit
  FROM sales_data
  WHERE Order_Date >= '2024-01-01' AND Order_Date < '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', Order_Date)
)
SELECT order_month,
       monthly_revenue,
       monthly_profit,
       ROUND(monthly_revenue - LAG(monthly_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month), 2) AS revenue_change_vs_prev_month
FROM monthly
ORDER BY order_month;
